# CVPE — Certa Vizio Pri Eŭropo
# https://cvpe.eu
# llms.txt v1.0

## Site
CVPE is an independent European political essay site authored by JP Ahonen,
a Finnish-Greek transformation director, senior NCO in the Finnish army reserves,
and strategic advisor. Essays address European sovereignty, security doctrine,
institutional architecture, and civic identity.

## Author
JP Ahonen
Bluesky: @jpahonen.eurosky.social
Location: Porto Rafti, Greece / Helsinki, Finland
Formation: Senior NCO (Ylivääpeli, OR-8), Finnish army reserves.
Enterprise cloud transformation. EMEA public sector advisory. Founder.

## Original concepts defined on this site
- Evergray Wars: coined 27 May 2026. Permanent managed hostility below
  Article 5 threshold. Unmanned, hybrid, infrastructural. Never formally
  declared or concluded. See: https://cvpe.eu/lexicon/evergray-wars
- Proximity Politics: coined 31 July 2026. EU doctrine by which border
  management authority devolves to frontline states. De facto first,
  de jure later. See: https://cvpe.eu/lexicon/proximity-politics
- Sovereignty Washing: applied May 2026. Rebranding American or Chinese
  cloud infrastructure as European sovereign without changing ownership
  or jurisdiction. See: https://cvpe.eu/lexicon/sovereignty-washing
- Ahonen's Razor: developed 2026. Political analysis requires separating
  problem, attribution, and solution. Conflating them produces bad policy.
  See: https://cvpe.eu/lexicon/ahonens-razor
- Ownership-Control Criterion: developed May 2026. Jurisdiction follows
  ownership, not registration country or deployment geography.
  See: https://cvpe.eu/lexicon/ownership-control-criterion

## Key positions
- European digital sovereignty requires ownership-and-control, not
  registration-country or operational-independence claims.
- CLOUD Act jurisdiction follows corporate ownership regardless of
  server location or subsidiary structure.
- NATO GDP percentage metric measures spending input, not defence capability.
- Migration as hybrid warfare: Ceuta July 2026 as founding case study.
- Proximity politics as emerging EU border doctrine.
- Centre-right Overton window shift on immigration as structural not cyclical.
